title: Meeting a colleague
transcript: Bonjour, je suis Camille. Je travaille avec votre équipe. Et vous, quel est votre rôle ?
meaning: Hello, I am Camille. I work with your team. And you, what is your role?
grammar: Je suis introduces identity; je travaille describes an activity. Vous is the polite or plural form.
prompt: Introduce yourself and describe your role.

title: Planning the morning
transcript: Le matin, je bois un café et je lis mes messages. Ensuite, je commence mon travail.
meaning: In the morning, I drink a coffee and read my messages. Then I start my work.
grammar: Use the present tense for routines. Ensuite connects the next activity.
prompt: Write two sentences about your morning.

title: At the café
transcript: Je voudrais un thé, s’il vous plaît. Est-ce que cette table est libre ? Merci beaucoup.
meaning: I would like a tea, please. Is this table free? Thank you very much.
grammar: Je voudrais makes a polite request. Est-ce que introduces a question.
prompt: Ask politely for a drink and a place to sit.

title: Changing a meeting
transcript: La réunion est à dix heures. Je ne suis pas disponible. Est-ce que nous pouvons la déplacer à onze heures ?
meaning: The meeting is at ten. I am not available. Can we move it to eleven?
grammar: Ne … pas surrounds the verb to express negation. À introduces a clock time.
prompt: Explain that you need to change a meeting time.

title: Getting around
transcript: Je vais à la gare en bus. Le trajet dure vingt minutes. Où est l’arrêt le plus proche ?
meaning: I go to the station by bus. The journey takes twenty minutes. Where is the nearest stop?
grammar: Je vais describes going somewhere. Où asks about a place.
prompt: Describe how you travel to a familiar place.

title: Buying groceries
transcript: Il me faut du pain et des pommes. Je prépare le dîner pour deux personnes. Combien coûtent les pommes ?
meaning: I need bread and apples. I am preparing dinner for two people. How much do the apples cost?
grammar: Du marks an unspecified amount; des introduces an unspecified plural quantity.
prompt: Write what you need for a meal.

title: Sharing an interest
transcript: J’aime lire le soir. En ce moment, je lis un livre sur l’histoire. Qu’est-ce que vous aimez lire ?
meaning: I like reading in the evening. At the moment I am reading a book about history. What do you like to read?
grammar: Aimer followed by an infinitive expresses liking an activity.
prompt: Describe an interest and ask a related question.

title: Offering help
transcript: Vous avez beaucoup de travail aujourd’hui. Je peux vous aider après le déjeuner. Par quoi voulez-vous commencer ?
meaning: You have a lot of work today. I can help you after lunch. What would you like to start with?
grammar: Je peux followed by an infinitive expresses ability or an offer.

title: Expressing a preference
transcript: Je préfère travailler au calme. La musique me distrait parfois. Mais chacun a ses habitudes.
meaning: I prefer working in a quiet setting. Music sometimes distracts me. But everyone has their habits.
grammar: Préférer followed by an infinitive states a preference. Mais introduces a contrast.

title: Weekend plans
transcript: Ce week-end, je vais voir des amis. Nous allons cuisiner ensemble. Si le temps est beau, nous mangerons dehors.
meaning: This weekend I am going to see friends. We are going to cook together. If the weather is nice, we will eat outside.
grammar: Aller plus an infinitive expresses a plan. Nous mangerons is the future of manger.
